description: Use as three flats, removal of ground floor rear extension and alterations to existing roof and dormer
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (001, 002, 003,  (dated 13/12/2013), 005, 006, 007, 008, 009, 010 (dated 06/02/2014), 004 (received 11/02/2014)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 4 - No windows shall be installed in the north eastern or south western elevations without the prior consent from the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 5 - The proposed property must only be used as three self contained flats (one in the side annex, one at ground floor and one at first floor) and for no other use.  No alterations shall be made to the internal layout including the subdivision of any rooms and the addition of any kitchens without the prior consent of the Local Planning Authority.
